title: A game where artificial intelligence manages your gameplay.
author: Practical_Yellow3154
selftext: I think I should turn this from a mod into part of the base game; since it's currently experimental, I haven't integrated it into the main game's progression yet. Here are the features of the god mode I added: rewinding and fast-forwarding time to instantly multiply monsters, multiple meteor strikes, shock-effect lightning strikes, flipping the screen and reversing controls, summoning 12 different bosses at random times and changing the map, grabbing the character and dropping them into dangerous areas, and summoning self-generated hybrid bosses. It has many more features like these and I'm still developing it.
